scope: Complete structural audit of shipped rows and overlays; full candidate source comparison; independent Vanilla NPC-name comparison; targeted public Wowhead quest checks. This is not certification of every Forever spawn or loot relationship.
policy: External absence or disagreement is a review signal, never grounds to delete Forever content. No Wowhead descriptions, comments or bulk database are imported.
